thread:
mia: Heads up — release pipeline is failing on the typegen regen check after the SDK semver bump. CI shows a regen diff for the OpenAPI-generated types when preparing v1.0.0.
ci-bot: CI job `typegen-check` failed on commit 9f3a2b7. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/9f3a2b7 (logs attached)
arjun: Pasted the small diff in the CI log — looks like enum/member/property ordering changed after the generator bump, plus one docstring punctuation change. Not sure which generator commit caused it. cc @sam
sam: We did merge the auth retry PR (#412) that adjusted the API spec and introduced a `retry_policy` object. That can be a breaking change depending on how SDK consumers introspect types.
olivia: If it's a breaking API shape change we need a clear changelog entry and a `BREAKING CHANGE` note. That said, CI should not fail for nondeterministic ordering alone.
mia: I can repro locally with `yarn run codegen:regen` — the diff is reproducible. Example command I ran locally:
```
# regenerate types
yarn install && yarn run codegen:regen
git --no-pager diff -- packages/sdk/src/generated
```
Result: only ordering and one trailing period in a description changed.
arjun: Quick fix idea: canonicalize emit order in the generator (sort properties/enums by key) so regen is deterministic. I'll open a patch with a unit test.
sam: Also note: release-please relies on conventional commits. The auth change commit is `feat(api): auth retry` which normally would be a minor bump, but since it changes the shape we need `BREAKING CHANGE` in the PR body so release tooling will perform a major bump.
olivia: I'll draft the changelog entry for the auth retry change and include migration notes for anyone using typed SDKs.
mia: Can we avoid relaxing CI? I'd rather land the ordering fix and keep the check strict.
arjun: Opened PR #789: "codegen: deterministic ordering for enums/properties + test". Local test command I ran: `yarn test:codegen` and it passes on my box. PTAL.
ci-bot: Rerun triggered for PR #789 — `typegen-check` rerun started.
ci-bot: Rerun complete: `typegen-check` passed for PR #789. Status: green.
sam: OK — once PR 789 lands, make sure the release PR for SDK includes `BREAKING CHANGE: auth retry shape` in the squash commit message/body so release-please bumps major. Also add the new changelog item under "Unreleased".
mia: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. I'll watch the release notes and coordinate with the release engineer to ensure the semver and changelog are correct before publishing.
